Package com.tonic.analysis.source.emit

Class SourceEmitter

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.source.emit.SourceEmitter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SourceVisitor<Void>
    public class SourceEmitter
extends Object
implements SourceVisitor<Void>
    Visitor that renders recovered AST nodes back to Java source text.
